_comment: RC5: the cross-library shared-atom vocabulary is CLOSED.
A `Shared`-marked row field is the only thing in this system that unifies across
package boundaries, so its spelling is a contract between brands that never see
each other's source. `shared:` used to be an open namespace: any string minted a
field, and a typo minted a field no other brand would ever name — a private kind
wearing cross-library clothes. That is exactly the `"html"` defect (RC5), where a
slot advertised 'arbitrary HTML goes here' and no native element could satisfy it.
This fixture exercises every entry point a shared role has:
Fix any one spelling and that error goes away; fix all three and this fixture STOPS
failing. The closed vocabulary is the load-bearing part.
